_note: Retrieval-only configs, all on Day 6 index A (618 chunks). 'use_filter' applies only the filter the user supplied with the question (never gold). Context = candidates packed under budget_chars (chars incl. the [id]/source header). Frozen configs used on test are listed in configs/selected.json.

R1_dense.hypothesis: Baseline: Day 6 dense retrieval (MiniLM 384d, Chroma cosine) + user edition filter, top-3 as context.

R2_bm25.hypothesis: Lexical BM25 matches exact numbers, years and economic terms (e.g. '2018', 'PMI') that a small multilingual embedder blurs.

R3_hybrid.hypothesis: RRF of dense+BM25 (50 candidates each, k=60) keeps semantic matches and adds exact-term matches; should beat both single retrievers on Hit@3.

R4_hybrid_rerank.hypothesis: A cross-encoder reading query and chunk jointly fixes ranking errors where the topic sentence outranks the chunk with the number (Day 6 q08, q20).

R5_dense_neighbors.hypothesis: Improvement on dev errors q08/q10: index A cuts a claim from its number across adjacent 500-char windows; adding same-page neighbors (c-1, c+1) of each top-3 hit to the context should raise Context Evidence Rate without changing ranking.

R6_hybrid_rerank_neighbors.hypothesis: Combine the two improvements: rerank fixes wrong-period top hits (q01), neighbors recover split evidence (q08); expect the best Context Evidence Rate at ~2x context chars.
